Tell CapEx from OpEx, say what TCO adds, and pick on-demand, committed use or spot for a workload.

show: 1. Cloud Computing Basics: Definition & the NIST view; on-premise IT vs cloud; drivers: cost, scale & speed

cards.title: Agenda

cards.heading: Agenda
show: 1. Cloud Deployment Models: Public cloud; private cloud: on-premise vs hosted; hybrid & cloud bursting; community cloud
2. Multi-Cloud: Motivations: resilience, negotiation & regulation; operational cost of multiple platforms
3. Service Models: IaaS, PaaS & SaaS: what each provides & abstracts; representative services (e.g. EC2 for IaaS, AWS Elastic Beanstalk for PaaS)
4. Beyond the Big Three: Function as a Service (FaaS) & serverless; AI/ML-as-a-Service; responsibility boundaries across models
5. Cloud Economics & Providers: CapEx vs OpEx; total cost of ownership (TCO); pricing: on-demand, committed use & spot; AWS, Azure, GCP & Indian providers
